Most people think moving to Dubai means instant luxury, skyline views, and a Dubai Bling lifestyle.

The reality is very different.

It’s walking under a scorching sun because a taxi costs too much.
It’s slippers breaking in the middle of the road.
It’s counting every dirham.
It’s missing home while chasing a dream that nobody else can see.

But if there’s one thing I’ve learned, it’s this:

Dubai rewards people who refuse to quit.

To everyone struggling today, keep going. This emirate has a way of giving back far more than you ever imagined, but only to those who stay long enough to earn it.
